in_sanskrit.name: Sunay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Radiance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sunay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sunay is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', meaning 'Sun'. It represents the radiance, warmth, and energy of the sun, making it a perfect name for a child who is full of life and vitality. In Hindu culture, the sun is also considered a symbol of power, strength, and illumination.
